$comment: Message catalogues load per route (E07 research R22, E03 T10): a message whose id starts with one of a part's prefixes is in that part, everything else is in core; a part loads when a page under one of its routes opens. Checked by scripts/catalogue-size.mjs.

forumAdmin.$comment: Also on the committee pages, which read a type's quorum sentence, outcome meanings and term words.

papers.$comment: A paper sent to a committee (Phase 4 E02 T4): its status and timeline, on the committee pages and on the memo page.

meetings.$comment: Meetings (Phase 4 E03 T6): the committee page's Meetings tab, a meeting's page, My meetings, and the My meetings card on the home page and the next meeting on the My committees cards.

agendaBuilder.$comment: The agenda builder (Phase 4 E03 T7): a meeting's agenda page and the committee type's Agenda tab. A route segment written $ matches any one segment.

meetingPage.$comment: The meeting page members read (Phase 4 E03 T8, flow P): the agenda, papers, What changed and consent requests.

meetingReplies.$comment: Invitations and replies (Phase 4 E05 T7, flows V and W): Will you attend? on the meeting page and the My meetings cards (also on the home page), Add to my calendar, and the officers' Invitations and replies tab.

meetingAttendance.$comment: Attendance and quorum at the meeting (Phase 4 E05 T8, flows X and Y): the officers’ Attendance tab, the live quorum banner and the per-item view, the members’ summary during the meeting, the forecast lines of the Invitations and replies tab, and the override dialog E06’s decisions open.

declarations.$comment: Declarations of interest (Phase 4 E04): declaring on the meeting page (T6, flow S); the officers' Declarations tab, the chair's decision and the builder's recused rows (T7, flow T); the register across committees at /declarations (T8, flow U).

minutes.$comment: Minutes (Phase 4 E06 T11, flows AD–AG): the minutes page per stage, the editor, the copy viewer, the meeting page’s Minutes card and the previous minutes’ link on the next agenda.

minutesToRead.$comment: Minutes to read in My meetings (Phase 4 E06 T11, flow AF1).

mySecurity.$comment: The user's own security page (sign-in methods, sessions), and only there: split from core when the meeting invitation texts (Phase 4 E05 T2) took the Arabic core past its limit.

notificationKinds.$comment: The text of each kind of notification, shown only in the notification list: split from core when the meeting reminders (Phase 4 E05 T6) would have taken the Arabic core past its limit.

analytics.$comment: Committee analytics (Phase 4 E08 T7, flows AU–AW): the overview, a committee's detail, attendance per member and a member's meetings.

decisionRegister.$comment: The decision register (Phase 4 E08 T6, flows AS and AT): search, filters, the number check and the export.

registerLinks.$comment: The register's entry points on other pages (E08 T6, design §1.6): Decisions of this committee on the committee page, and In the register on a resolution's page (a page that places it adds its route here).

actions.$comment: Committee actions, the owner's and members' side (Phase 4 E07 T11, flows AK, AL, AO, AP): My actions in the inbox, the action page with its dialogs, timeline and follow-up memos, and the action taken report page. Also on the meeting and committee pages (E07 T10), whose action lists, tracker and forms use its words (colours, statuses, owners, dates).

actionLinks.$comment: The few action texts other pages show (Phase 4 E07 T11): the Matters arising item's link to its action taken report on the agenda, and Raised from action on the memo.

decisions.$comment: Recording decisions (Phase 4 E06 T10, flows AA and AB): the officers’ Decisions tab on the meeting page, notes, consent sections and corrections, what Mark the meeting as held says will happen (also from the committee page’s meeting menu), and the decisions on the members’ agenda.

resolutions.$comment: Resolutions (Phase 4 E06 T10, flow AC): the committee’s register, one resolution, certified extracts and the starting number.

forumMinutes.$comment: The committee type’s Minutes tab (Phase 4 E06 T10, flow AI): how minutes are approved, when memos move on, resolution numbers and the minutes template.

actionsOfficer.$comment: Committee actions, the secretary's side (Phase 4 E07 T10, flows AJ, AM, AN): raising actions from the decision panel and the meeting page, the action form, drafts and Send the drafts, the line in Mark as held (also from the committee page's meeting menu), the officers' buttons and verification on the action page, closing at the meeting on the report, and the committee's tracker.

forumActions.$comment: The committee type's Actions tab (Phase 4 E07 T10, flow AQ): red, amber and green, new dates, verification, evidence, the default due date, update requests and the workflow.
